poses.label: Front Neutral
poses.prompt: front-facing neutral head-and-shoulders portrait, direct gaze, relaxed expression
poses.review_rule: Require a clear front-facing neutral portrait with direct gaze.

poses.label: Front Smile
poses.prompt: front-facing head-and-shoulders portrait, natural confident smile, direct gaze
poses.geometry_prompt: mandatory clearly visible genuine smile: (raised mouth corners, parted lips, visible upper teeth, lifted rounded cheeks, subtle smile lines beside the mouth, bright engaged eyes:1.45), the smile must be unmistakably different from a neutral or closed-mouth expression
poses.review_rule: Require an unmistakable genuine smile with raised mouth corners and lifted cheeks.

poses.label: Three Quarter Left
poses.prompt: natural three-quarter head-and-shoulders portrait, head yaw rotated 40 to 45 degrees toward the left side of the image, nose and chin clearly angle left, near cheek dominant and far cheek narrower, both eyes visible with the far eye naturally narrower, near ear may remain visible through or beside the hair, eyes looking slightly off camera toward the left edge, not a straight-on frontal face and not a full side profile
poses.geometry_prompt: mandatory natural three-quarter head yaw: face turned 40 to 45 degrees toward the left side of the image, nose tip and chin angled toward the left edge, facial centerline visibly angled away from camera, both eyes visible with the far eye naturally narrower, far cheek narrower but still visible, near cheek dominant, near ear optionally visible through or beside the hair, slightly off-camera gaze, no straight-on camera pose
poses.review_rule: Require a natural 40 to 45 degree left three-quarter portrait with both eyes visible and reject frontal or full-profile results.

poses.label: Three Quarter Right
poses.prompt: natural three-quarter head-and-shoulders portrait, head yaw rotated 40 to 45 degrees toward the right side of the image, nose and chin clearly angle right, near cheek dominant and far cheek narrower, both eyes visible with the far eye naturally narrower, near ear may remain visible through or beside the hair, eyes looking slightly off camera toward the right edge, not a straight-on frontal face and not a full side profile
poses.geometry_prompt: mandatory natural three-quarter head yaw: face turned 40 to 45 degrees toward the right side of the image, nose tip and chin angled toward the right edge, facial centerline visibly angled away from camera, both eyes visible with the far eye naturally narrower, far cheek narrower but still visible, near cheek dominant, near ear optionally visible through or beside the hair, slightly off-camera gaze, no straight-on camera pose
poses.review_rule: Require a natural 40 to 45 degree right three-quarter portrait with both eyes visible and reject frontal or full-profile results.

poses.label: Slight Down
poses.prompt: head-and-shoulders portrait with face angled slightly downward, eyes toward viewer
poses.review_rule: Require a subtle downward head angle while keeping the face readable.

poses.label: Slight Up
poses.prompt: head-and-shoulders portrait with face angled slightly upward, eyes toward viewer
poses.review_rule: Require a subtle upward head angle while keeping the face readable.
